title: videotapes.io film (v2)
description: A film and its approved sleeves. Films are keyed by TMDb ID; fetch anything else about the film (overview, genres, cast) from TMDb.

tmdbId.description: The film's ID on The Movie Database (themoviedb.org): the key everything here hangs on.

title.description: The film's English (US) title on TMDb.

sleeves.description: Approved sleeves: releases first, then fan-made ones if asked for; newest first within each.

licence.description: The metadata is CC0; the artwork belongs to its rights holders.

attribution.description: How to credit videotapes.io (appreciated, not required for CC0 metadata).
